title: Boone County Planning Commission — Grading Plan application current source verification
evidenceScope: The preserved Boone County Planning Commission Applications and Forms page links GradingPlan.pdf under the label Grading Plan, and that exact official PDF returned HTTP 200 with application/pdf content on 2026-10-01. This establishes current source identity and category availability only. It does not by itself establish when a Grading Plan is required, which projects, parcels, disturbances, or jurisdictions it applies to, every requirement or fee, submission workflow, approval standard, or applicability to a particular sign project. No sign-project requirement should be inferred from this source without additional current official evidence or staff review.
